other_text: Deadly Underground Human Organ Black Market Harvesting Traders! Human organ transplants globally have dropped in numbers and, as hospitals have closed or filled with capacity-clogged resources for COVID-19, the pandemic created backlogs of patients on waiting lists. Underground hospitals have started popping up in Detroit!
